ddl.definition:
select "title_id", "title_kind", "version_ts", 
          array_remove(
            array_agg("sq_translations"."translation"),
            NULL
          )
         as "translations" from (select "title_id", "title_kind", "version_ts", 
          jsonb_build_object(
            'iso_3166_1',
            "iso_3166_1",
            'iso_639_1',
            "iso_639_1"
          ) || jsonb_object_agg(
            "field"::TEXT,
            "value"
          )
         as "translation" from "tmdb"."title_translation" group by "tmdb"."title_translation"."title_id", "tmdb"."title_translation"."title_kind", "tmdb"."title_translation"."iso_3166_1", "tmdb"."title_translation"."iso_639_1", "tmdb"."title_translation"."version_ts") "sq_translations" group by "sq_translations"."title_id", "sq_translations"."title_kind", "sq_translations"."version_ts"
ddl.name: title_translation_view
